featured_reviews.review_text:
I'd like to share my experience with Mahavir Decor.

Recommended by my wife watching it online, I went to the store with a lot of excitement and hope to get the best at reasonable price.

The staffs working there all looked like an owner of the store the way they all welcomed us and greeted us politely.

We explained that we've come after a long wait so please do not disappoint us in quality and in pricing.

We got what we liked at a discounted price however there came a twist. The supplier of the wall vinyl turned up and said that the design we liked is now over and it will be available in 15 days.

We felt upset and disappointed as we had started imagining it and suddenly it all crashed. We wanted it in the next 3 days and we couldn't wait for 15 days now.

This led me to walk up to the store and speak to a person who was polite. He asked me to wait to speak to someone who maybe able to help me.

Things weren't working out still and finally Shreeya, came into the picture. Another staff but little different than others. She took matters in her hand, understood our side and helped us to get an alternative options with some compensation for the inconveniences caused. She valued us over everything else and because of this we bought even the bird net from them.

Even during the bird net installation process, though everyone gave up as we wanted it within 2 days. She took ownership again and suggested the vendor to get it done in two days only.

I liked the gesture and was much impressed. All the staffs are good and polite but one thing that I liked about Shreeya which makes her stand out is her way of understanding customer's needs, going that extra mile for customer satisfaction. I'm sure that wherever she works whether for herself as a business Owner or for someone as an employee, she will do wonders because she has pure and true intentions for her customer.

Appreciate her work and it's commendable!
